import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Combine selected features and target for plotting
data_check = X_selected.copy()
data_check['diabetes'] = y

# Plot each feature vs diabetes using logistic regression trend
for col in X_selected.columns:
    plt.figure(figsize=(6, 4))
    sns.regplot(x=col, y='diabetes', data=data_check, logistic=True, ci=None, line_kws={"color": "red"})
    plt.title(f"Linearity Check: {col} vs Diabetes")
    plt.show()
In [98]:
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, confusion_matrix, classification_report, precision_score, recall_score, f1_score
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.metrics import ConfusionMatrixDisplay
from sklearn.metrics import roc_curve, auc
# Drop NaNs from test data
X_test_clean = X_test.dropna()
y_test_clean = y_test.loc[X_test_clean.index]

# Train and predict
model = RandomForestClassifier()
model.fit(X_train, y_train)
y_pred = model.predict(X_test_clean)

# Accuracy
accuracy = accuracy_score(y_test_clean, y_pred)
print(f"Accuracy: {accuracy:.2f}")

# Confusion Matrix
print("Confusion Matrix:")
print(confusion_matrix(y_test_clean, y_pred))

# Classification Report
print("Classification Report:")
print(classification_report(y_test_clean, y_pred))

# Precision, Recall, F1
precision = precision_score(y_test_clean, y_pred)
recall = recall_score(y_test_clean, y_pred)
f1 = f1_score(y_test_clean, y_pred)
print(f"Precision: {precision:.2f}")
print(f"Recall: {recall:.2f}")
print(f"F1 Score: {f1:.2f}")

# Plot Confusion Matrix
cm = confusion_matrix(y_test_clean, y_pred)
disp = ConfusionMatrixDisplay(confusion_matrix=cm)
disp.plot(cmap=plt.cm.Blues)
plt.title(" Random Forest Confusion Matrix")
plt.show()

# ROC curve
y_probs = model.predict_proba(X_test_clean)[:, 1]
fpr, tpr, _ = roc_curve(y_test_clean, y_probs)
roc_auc = auc(fpr, tpr)

plt.figure(figsize=(6, 5))
plt.plot(fpr, tpr, label=f"Random Forest (AUC = {roc_auc:.2f})", color='green')
plt.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], 'k--')
plt.xlabel("False Positive Rate")
plt.ylabel("True Positive Rate")
plt.title("ROC Curve - Random Forest")
plt.legend(loc="lower right")
plt.grid(True)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, confusion_matrix, classification_report, precision_score, recall_score, f1_score, ConfusionMatrixDisplay
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Clean training data
X_train_clean = X_train.dropna()
y_train_clean = y_train.loc[X_train_clean.index]

# Train KNN model
model = KNeighborsClassifier(n_neighbors=5)
model.fit(X_train_clean, y_train_clean)

# Predict
y_pred = model.predict(X_test_clean)

# Evaluation
accuracy = accuracy_score(y_test_clean, y_pred)
print(f"Accuracy: {accuracy:.2f}")
print("Confusion Matrix:")
print(confusion_matrix(y_test_clean, y_pred))
print("Classification Report:")
print(classification_report(y_test_clean, y_pred))

precision = precision_score(y_test_clean, y_pred)
recall = recall_score(y_test_clean, y_pred)
f1 = f1_score(y_test_clean, y_pred)
print(f"Precision: {precision:.2f}")
print(f"Recall: {recall:.2f}")
print(f"F1 Score: {f1:.2f}")

# Plot confusion matrix
ConfusionMatrixDisplay.from_predictions(y_test_clean, y_pred, cmap=plt.cm.Blues)
plt.title("KNN Confusion Matrix")
plt.show()

# ROC curve
y_probs = model.predict_proba(X_test_clean)[:, 1]
fpr, tpr, _ = roc_curve(y_test_clean, y_probs)
roc_auc = auc(fpr, tpr)

plt.figure(figsize=(6, 5))
plt.plot(fpr, tpr, label=f"KNN (AUC = {roc_auc:.2f})", color='green')
plt.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], 'k--')
plt.xlabel("False Positive Rate")
plt.ylabel("True Positive Rate")
plt.title("ROC Curve - KNN")
plt.legend(loc="lower right")
plt.grid(True)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

model.fit(X_train_clean, y_train_clean)

y_pred = model.predict(X_test_clean)

accuracy = accuracy_score(y_test_clean, y_pred)
print(f"Accuracy: {accuracy:.2f}")
print("Confusion Matrix:")
print(confusion_matrix(y_test_clean, y_pred))
print("Classification Report:")
print(classification_report(y_test_clean, y_pred))

precision = precision_score(y_test_clean, y_pred)
recall = recall_score(y_test_clean, y_pred)

print(f"Recall: {recall:.2f}")

model = GaussianNB()
model.fit(X_train_clean, y_train_clean)
y_pred = model.predict(X_test_clean)

accuracy = accuracy_score(y_test_clean, y_pred)
print(f"Accuracy: {accuracy:.2f}")
print("Confusion Matrix:")
print(confusion_matrix(y_test_clean, y_pred))
print("Classification Report:")
print(classification_report(y_test_clean, y_pred))

print(f"Precision: {precision_score(y_test_clean, y_pred):.2f}")
print(f"Recall: {recall_score(y_test_clean, y_pred):.2f}")
print(f"F1 Score: {f1_score(y_test_clean, y_pred):.2f}")

ConfusionMatrixDisplay.from_predictions(y_test_clean, y_pred, cmap=plt.cm.Blues)
plt.title("Naive Bayes Confusion Matrix")
plt.show()

# ROC curve
y_probs = model.predict_proba(X_test_clean)[:, 1]
fpr, tpr, _ = roc_curve(y_test_clean, y_probs)
roc_auc = auc(fpr, tpr)

plt.figure(figsize=(6, 5))
plt.plot(fpr, tpr, label=f"Naive Bayes (AUC = {roc_auc:.2f})", color='green')
plt.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], 'k--')
plt.xlabel("False Positive Rate")
plt.ylabel("True Positive Rate")
plt.title("ROC Curve - Naive Bayes")
plt.legend(loc="lower right")
plt.grid(True)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

import pickle

from sklearn.datasets import load_iris
